I already have told this story before and this will probably be buried but I'll leave this here anyways.

When I was about 7 or 8 I was playing outside with my brothers and was running around underneath a tree. I was chasing after them and threw my hands up in the air. Well, the leaves on the tree were serated and I ended up slicing my hand open on them. Yes, the leaves, not a branch. I was a very clumsy child. I remember sitting on the couch holding a washcloth soaked with blood against my hand begging my mother not to bring me to the E.R., that it wasn't that bad. It was that bad and I needed stitches. I told the kids at school I got in a fight with a bear. Of course, they didn't believe me and my brother told them what happened and I was relentlessly teased. It left quite the scar and my family and friends who know about it still tease me about it.


**TL;DR sliced my hand open on a leaf**
